stories.script:
Rayo: Friends, today is the Big Race Day in Sunny Town!
Bella: I am so excited! My flowers are ready and my engine is singing!
Rusty: Howdy! I checked the road. It is safe and smooth for everyone!
Rayo: Remember, the race is not only about winning. Helping is winning too!
Bella: Look, the starting line! Red, yellow, green... get ready!
Rayo: Vroom! I am fast like the wind!
Bella: Wait for me, Rayo! My little wheels are dancing!
Rusty: Easy there, friends! The bridge is narrow. One by one!
Rayo: Oh no, a baby duck family is crossing the road!
Bella: Stop, stop! Let the little ducks cross safely!
Rusty: Good job, kids! Kind drivers always stop for others.
Rayo: The ducks are safe! Now the race can start again!
Bella: The mountain road is so pretty! Flowers on both sides!
Rayo: Almost there! I can see the finish flag!
Bella: Rayo, your tire looks soft! Pull over, I will help!
Rayo: Thank you, Bella! You are a true friend!
Rusty: A little air, a happy heart, and we are rolling again!
Bella: Together we finish! That is the best prize!
Rayo: We did it! Friends first, trophies second!
Rusty: See you at the next race, friends! Bye bye!
stories.title: The Big Race Day

stories.script:
Bella: Oh no! My little teddy is lost! I had it at the picnic!
Rayo: Do not worry, Bella! We will find your teddy together!
Rusty: Howdy! A lost teddy case? Detective Rusty is on the job!
Bella: We had sandwiches under the big tree. Teddy was with me!
Rayo: Then let us start at the picnic tree!
Rusty: Look, tiny footprints in the sand! Something carried it away!
Bella: Maybe the wind took it to the beach?
Rayo: To the beach! Fast but careful!
Bella: I see something brown near the rocks!
Rusty: Easy, that is only a coconut! Keep looking, friends!
Rayo: Wait! Music! The ice cream cart is playing our song!
Bella: Teddy loved ice cream time! Maybe it is near the cart!
Rusty: Look under the cart's umbrella... there it is!
Bella: My teddy! You are safe! Thank you, thank you!
Rayo: A friend in need is a friend indeed!
Rusty: Case closed! Detective Rusty did it again!
Bella: I will hold teddy tight on every trip now!
Rayo: And we will always help each other. That is our promise!
Bella: Best friends forever! Bye bye!
Rusty: Bye bye, friends! See you on the next adventure!
stories.title: The Lost Teddy
